question: Import taste-skill (Leonxlnx/taste-skill)
choice: Import v2.1.5 commit 12af471f to .agent/skills/design-taste-frontend and global config

question: Select 100% free cloud deployment topology for GoCar Auto
choice: Cloudflare Pages (SPAs) + Render.com Docker (Backend API) + TiDB Cloud Serverless (MySQL DB) + Cloudflare R2 (10GB Object Storage) + cron-job.org (Cold-start ping)
rationale: Zero ongoing cost (bash.00/mo), eliminates cold starts via 10-min keep-alive ping, no credit card required for TiDB, zero bandwidth overage fees on Cloudflare Pages, full native compatibility with Express and React Vite frontends

question: Define mandatory software engineering and deployment lifecycle workflow
choice: Strict 3-Stage Tiered Lifecycle: 1. Local Antigravity Development & Verification (Localhost) -> 2. GitHub Version Control & Automated CI -> 3. Live Production Edge (Cloudflare Pages + Render + TiDB Cloud)
rationale: Guarantees zero regressions, zero untested code reaching production, full traceability of changes in Git, and automated CI gate enforcement before live deployment.

question: Which design system toolkit to use for redesigning the customer portal
rationale: Adopted pbakaus/impeccable (Apache 2.0) for design vocabulary, anti-slop rules, critique, and precision UI craft across the customer portal

question: Migrate Edge Frontends from Cloudflare Pages to Vercel
options: Stay on Cloudflare Pages with custom domain
Migrate both frontends to Vercel
choice: Migrate both customer portal and staff interface to Vercel Edge Network (https://gocarauto.vercel.app & https://gocarauto-3kpg.vercel.app)
rationale: Cloudflare Pages Anycast IP routing (188.114.97.x) encounters regional ISP blackholing in Egypt causing connection timeouts. Vercel routes reliably across Egyptian ISPs with zero downtime and clean SPA rewrite support.

question: Framework and architecture for full-application mobile and tablet responsiveness
options: Import heavy UI library
Leverage existing impeccable adapt engine
rationale: Impeccable adapt engine specifies exact mobile/tablet heuristics (thumbs-first bottom navigation, table-to-card adaptive views, touch target >= 44px, bottom sheets instead of centered modals) without adding external dependency bloat or breaking zero-error bundle targets.

question: Theme architecture to unify Staff Interface visual styling with Customer Portal
options: Keep staff interface dark-only
Unify staff interface with persistent ThemeProvider and light/dark theme parity matching Customer Portal
choice: Unify staff interface with ThemeProvider, localStorage theme synchronization, light mode by default, and dark mode toggle
rationale: Provides visual parity across both public and operational platforms using shared Tailwind v4 design tokens, high-contrast light mode cards, accessible badges, and seamless instant theme switching without page reloads.

question: Zero-Destructive Database Discipline & Data Protection Gate
options: Allow manual script execution without safety checks
Enact ValdoZ Directive 13 requiring automated pre-reset snapshots, --force-reset flag, and cloud sync tooling
choice: Enact ValdoZ Directive 13 requiring automated pre-reset snapshots in backups/db/, mandatory --force-reset flag, and non-destructive cloud synchronization via npm run sync:db
rationale: Prevents catastrophic data loss during database maintenance and automated test cycles. Guarantees that active local databases cannot be wiped unconditionally, protects customer and operational data, and provides instant restoration capability from TiDB Cloud.

question: Vehicle blueprint sketches standardization, alignment, and asset repair
options: Leave existing corrupt duplications and generic sedan fallbacks

Standardize all vehicle sketches to transparent RGBA blueprints, separate model duplicates, and deploy token-based fuzzy resolver in sketchHelper.js synchronized across Customer Portal and Staff Interface
choice: Standardize all vehicle sketches to 800px transparent RGBA blueprints, repair corrupt asset duplications (Nissan Sunny/Corolla separating from Ford Focus; SUV/Van separating from Sedan), and deploy token-based fuzzy resolver in sketchHelper.js synchronized across Customer Portal and Staff Interface
rationale: Ensures 100% of customer vehicles render accurate body types and specific models without visual collisions, dark bounding box artifacts, or missing assets on the obsidian hero stage.

question: Full fleet automotive CAD wireframe technical sketches generation, compression, and cross-generation mapping
options: Ship uncompressed 117MB raw JPEG images directly to production

Resize to high-DPI 1200x896, compress to optimized WebP (94.5% size reduction) and PNG, map identical generation years across fleet, and expand sketchHelper.js with 123 slugs across Customer Portal and Staff Interface
choice: Resize to high-DPI 1200x896, compress to optimized WebP (94.5% size reduction, dropping fleet size from 117MB to 6.4MB) and PNG, map identical generation years across fleet, and expand sketchHelper.js with 123 slugs across Customer Portal and Staff Interface
rationale: Achieves 100% exact model coverage across all 59 registered vehicles in database with 0 generic fallbacks, preserves raw uncompressed masters in sketches-raw/, and cuts asset payload by 94.5% for ultra-fast mobile loading on Customer Portal and Staff Interface.

question: Customer Portal Onboarding & Mandatory First-Time Password Flow Architecture
options: Require passwords upfront during client creation in workshop
Allow 1-tap WhatsApp magic link entry with 30-day token, mandatory non-dismissible FirstTimePasswordModal on dashboard, and phone number designated as username
choice: Allow 1-tap WhatsApp magic link entry with 30-day token, mandatory non-dismissible FirstTimePasswordModal on dashboard, and phone number designated as username
rationale: Allows frictionless first-time onboarding for 57 legacy clients without pre-set passwords while guaranteeing account security via mandatory in-app password creation before garage access. Single-asterisk WhatsApp markdown formatting ensures clean bilingual presentation on mobile devices.

question: Service Passport Redesign, Font Character Integrity & Financial Stats Parity

Provide dual-path rendering: responsive HTML browser view with print/save button matching Invoice theme, plus TrueType Arabic font shaping for PDFKit fallback, and harmonize totalInvested across portal

Matches the GoCar Auto Invoice Design Theme (Outfit & Cairo fonts, navy #0b192c, orange #f97316) and adds 1-click browser vector print export.

question: Staff Interface Primary Action Button Layout & Border-Radius Harmonization
options: Require all developers to write className='btn btn-primary'
Upgrade .btn-primary, .btn-neutral, and .btn-outline with self-contained button geometry and rounded-xl styles
choice: Upgrade .btn-primary, .btn-neutral, and .btn-outline with self-contained button geometry and rounded-xl styles
rationale: Prevents harsh unstyled 90-degree rectangle buttons across forms and views when components declare className='btn-primary' without the .btn prefix. Aligns primary action buttons with .btn-secondary in padding, border-radius, font-weight, and interactive transitions.

question: App-Wide Button Alignment, DOM Nesting Elimination, and Strict Human Gate for Deployments
options: Leave nested <Link><button> elements and allow auto-pushes to remote

Refactor all 12 nested <Link><button> anti-patterns to direct <Link className>, equalize icon button dimensions, audit all 223 buttons across Customer Portal and Staff Interface, and enforce strict human gate before any git push
choice: Refactor all 12 nested <Link><button> anti-patterns to direct <Link className>, equalize icon button dimensions, audit all 223 buttons across Customer Portal and Staff Interface, and enforce strict human gate before any git push
rationale: Eliminates DOM hierarchy violations where <button> was nested inside <a>/Link, causing event double-firing and styling discrepancies. Confirms 100% of 223 buttons across both applications have verified classes and rounded geometries. Re-affirms strict zero-push policy requiring explicit user approval prior to any production deployment.

question: Vehicle Decommissioning, Mandatory Archival Reasons, Reminder Cancellation and Isolation
options: Hard DELETE vehicles from database

Additive soft-delete schema (is_archived, archive_reason, archive_notes, archived_at, archived_by), mandatory reasons modal in staff UI, immediate pending reminder cancellation, reminder engine isolation, and active vs archived fleet filter
choice: Additive soft-delete schema (is_archived, archive_reason, archive_notes, archived_at, archived_by), mandatory reasons modal in staff UI, immediate pending reminder cancellation, reminder engine isolation, and active vs archived fleet filter
rationale: Guarantees Zero-Destructive Database Discipline (Directive 13) preserving historical invoice records and workshop ledgers while preventing decommissioned (sold, scrapped, deceased owner, replaced) vehicles from triggering future service reminders, notifications, or appearing in active customer garage or booking selections.
